title: Media Buy Delivery Webhook Result
description: Payload-only delivery report result carried under core/mcp-webhook-payload.json result for task_type media_buy_delivery. This is not a top-level webhook POST body and does not include protocol envelope fields such as task_id or status. `aggregated_totals` is API-only (`get_media_buy_delivery`) and MUST NOT appear in this payload; see webhooks.mdx.

verifier_constraints.row_currency_consistency: When media_buy_deliveries[].currency is present, every present by_package[].currency MUST equal it
verifier_constraints.legacy_currency_consistency: When deprecated response-wide currency is present, every present media-buy and package currency MUST equal it
verifier_constraints.package_currency_presence: When a package has spend or another currency-denominated monetary value and both the media-buy row currency and deprecated response-wide currency are absent, that package MUST include currency
verifier_constraints.mixed_currency_row: When packages in a legacy or externally created media buy use different currencies, the row currency and all monetary or money-derived values in row totals MUST be omitted
verifier_constraints.multi_qualifier_totals: When the buy's packages report a metric_id under more than one qualifier set (in by_package[].metric_values or a package's flat carrier), that metric's flat carrier (the whole nested object) MUST be omitted from row totals; the identity key is (scope, metric_id, qualifier)

notification_type.description: Type of delivery-report notification: scheduled = regular periodic update, final = campaign completed, delayed = data not yet available, adjusted = corrected data for the same window, window_update = a wider measurement window supersedes a prior window.

partial_data.description: Indicates if any media buys in this webhook have missing or delayed data.

unavailable_count.description: Number of media buys with reporting_delayed or failed status when partial_data is true.

sequence_number.description: Sequential notification number for this reporting webhook stream.

next_expected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for the next expected notification. Omitted on final notifications.

reporting_period.description: Period covered by the delivery report. start and end are instants on the reporting timezone's period boundaries (the products' reporting_capabilities.timezone, echoed in timezone). They fall on UTC midnight only when that timezone is UTC.

currency.description: Deprecated in AdCP 3.2 and removed in AdCP 4.0. Optional legacy report-wide ISO 4217 currency code. It may be used only when every monetary value in the report has that denomination. A report can contain media buys with different currencies, so buyers MUST NOT interpret this field as an aggregation currency or evidence of currency conversion. Prefer media_buy_deliveries[].currency when present and package-level currency otherwise.

attribution_window.description: Attribution methodology and lookback windows used for conversion metrics in this report.

media_buy_deliveries.description: Delivery rows for one or more media buys included in this notification.
